rationale: With l13 out, the base case overloads l12 (100 MW vs 75 MW, 133.3%). Closing the normally-open tie l14 redistributes flow and brings every branch within rating: l12=70.71 MW (94.3%), l14=29.29 MW (58.6%), l23=33.57 MW (67.1%), l24=17.14 MW (34.3%), l34=16.43 MW (32.9%). Opening any single branch (l23, l24, or l34) leaves l12 at 100 MW (133.3%), infeasible. Only one switching action is used and the network stays connected.
